_note_1: Template for CsV3Sb5. Replace orbital indices with the positions of the V-d Wannier functions in YOUR wannier90_hr.dat (0-based), and fermi_energy with the DFT Fermi level used for the Wannierisation.
_note_2: Class labels reproduce ComRISB's impurity_problem_equivalence = [1, 2, 2]: V1 alone, V2 = V3 share parameters. For the pristine P6/mmm structure all three V are equivalent; then give all three the same class.
_note_3: basis 'cf' rotates each V-d shell to the eigenbasis of its own local Hamiltonian, so symmetry-equivalent V sites with different orbital orientations share parameters. structure 'auto' detects the symmetry-allowed R/Lambda pattern from the data (in D2h: dz2 and dx2-y2 are both Ag and may mix). Check 'ansatz_residual' in results.json.
_note_4: charge_feedback: V_H is the screened Hartree+xc response dε/dN of each shell; best taken from a Cococcioni-de Gironcoli linear-response calculation (U_LR) for V-d and Sb-p. Values below are placeholders. Remove all 'feedback' entries and the charge_feedback block for one-shot DFT+RISB.
_note_5: Sb-p orbital indices below are placeholders: list ALL Sb-p WFs of your hr.dat (0-based).
